contract.name: Thandi
injuries: left achilles niggle, avoid hills and speed on consecutive days
contract.notes: Runs mornings before work. Sunday is the only day with time for a long run.

plan.week_summary: This week builds baseline endurance towards the sub-4 marathon goal with 288 total minutes. It features two non-consecutive hard sessions (intervals on Tuesday, tempo on Thursday) kept on flat terrain to protect the left Achilles, balanced by structured easy runs, a dedicated Friday rest day, and a 98-minute Sunday long run.

days.title: Monday Easy Aerobic
days.structure: 35 min easy jog at conversational pace on flat terrain

days.title: Flat Speed Intervals
days.structure: 10 min easy warm-up, 5 x 3 min at 10k effort with 2 min easy walk/jog recovery on flat ground, 5 min easy cool-down

days.title: Mid-Week Recovery Run
days.structure: 35 min gentle recovery run on flat path, focus on smooth cadence

days.title: Marathon Pace Tempo
days.structure: 10 min easy warm-up, 25 min steady at goal marathon pace (~5:40/km) on flat terrain, 10 min easy cool-down

days.title: Complete Rest Day
days.structure: No running; full rest and Achilles calf gentle self-massage

days.title: Saturday Aerobic Flush
days.structure: 35 min relaxed morning run on soft, flat surfaces

days.title: Sunday Endurance Long Run
days.structure: 98 min steady long run at easy conversational effort, practice race hydration strategy on flat route
